seoTitle: Which New Girl Character Are You? New Girl Loft Test (10 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the New Girl test: 10 everyday questions reveal whether you're Jess, Nick, Schmidt, Winston or Cece — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the quirky optimist who bursts into song, the grumpy softie who keeps his cash in a shoebox, or the one with the 12-step skincare routine? Answer 10 questions about how you really handle friends, roommates and everyday life, and find out which New Girl character you are.

characters.name: Jess Day
characters.title: The Adorkable Optimist
characters.summary: Quirky, warm and relentlessly positive. You burst into song, you believe in people, and you're tougher than you look.
description: Like Jess, you're unapologetically yourself. Polka dots, made-up songs and a laugh nobody forgets.
You're a teacher at heart. Jess cares deeply about her students — and later runs a school — and she brings that same caring to her friends.
People underestimate how strong you are. They shouldn't. You'll fight for the people you love.
characters.flaw: You meddle, and you can be a lot to handle when you're excited.
characters.signature: A vintage dress, a made-up song and a very enthusiastic wave.
characters.clashReason: they'd be far too cheerful before breakfast

characters.name: Nick Miller
characters.title: The Grumpy Softie
characters.summary: Grumpy, stubborn and totally avoidant of responsibility. But you've got the biggest heart in the loft.
description: Like Nick, you complain about everything. Doctors, change, technology, anything new — but you're secretly one of the most loyal friends anyone could have.
You avoid responsibility like it's your job. Nick is a bartender who keeps his money in a shoebox and his feelings even more tightly packed.
You've got hidden talents too. Nick spent years writing his detective novel, The Pepperwood Chronicles — and it actually got published.
characters.flaw: You're stubborn and you avoid anything that looks like being an adult.
characters.signature: A bar towel, a grumpy face and a very bad detective novel.
characters.clashReason: they'd refuse to deal with anything, ever

characters.name: Schmidt
characters.title: The Well-Groomed Try-Hard
characters.summary: Ambitious, particular and very well moisturised. You try way too hard — and you're secretly the most romantic person in the loft.
description: Like Schmidt, you care about appearances. Your skincare routine is serious, your clothes are sharp and your standards are high.
You say things you shouldn't. That's why the loft has a douchebag jar — and why you pay into it more than anyone.
But underneath all that, you're loyal, sentimental and completely devoted to the people you love, especially Cece.
characters.flaw: You're vain and you say the wrong thing, a lot.
characters.signature: A tailored suit, expensive cologne and a very full douchebag jar.
characters.clashReason: they'd make rules for everything and fine you for breaking them

characters.name: Winston Bishop
characters.title: The Lovable Weirdo
characters.summary: Silly, sweet and gloriously strange. You love pranks, puzzles and your cat — and you're a better friend than anyone realises.
description: Like Winston, you're wonderfully weird. You love pranks — even if you're famously bad at them — and your cat, Ferguson, is basically your child.
You've reinvented yourself. Winston came back from playing pro basketball in Latvia with no plan, and ended up a police officer.
You're sensitive and silly, and you're the one who makes the loft feel like home.
characters.flaw: You overthink small things and get very competitive about pranks.
characters.signature: A cat called Ferguson, a jigsaw puzzle and a prank that goes wrong.
characters.clashReason: they'd take a prank war way too far

characters.name: Cece
characters.title: The Cool, Confident Best Friend
characters.summary: Confident, stylish and fiercely protective of your best friend. You don't take nonsense from anyone.
description: Like Cece, you're effortlessly cool. She's a model with a sharp tongue and very little patience for nonsense.
You're a fiercely loyal best friend. Cece has been by Jess's side since they were kids.
You come across as tough, but you're sensitive underneath — and you fall for people harder than you'd like to admit.
characters.flaw: You put up walls and hide how much you care.
characters.signature: A great outfit, a raised eyebrow and a straight answer.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you the brutal truth

questions.text: Someone breaks a house rule. You...

options.text: Bring in a system of fines
Talk it through with a heartfelt chat
Shrug. Rules are more like suggestions
Take it way more personally than it deserves

questions.text: A friend is having a crisis. You...

options.text: Show up with snacks and a plan to fix everything
Go after whoever caused it
Give a grumpy but surprisingly wise speech
Make a grand gesture that's slightly too much

questions.text: You're trying out a new hobby. It's...

options.text: Cooking. You make your own pasta now
Yoga. You're already better than the instructor
Writing a novel. Nobody's allowed to read it
Crafts. The whole flat's covered in glitter

questions.text: You really need to go to the doctor. You...

options.text: Absolutely not
Get it done. No big deal
Book it, then overthink the results for a week
Go — and end up chatting with everyone in the waiting room

questions.text: The group has a free weekend. What do you want to do?

options.text: A 1,000-piece jigsaw puzzle
A themed game night — costumes optional
Somewhere with a dress code
Nothing. That's the point of a weekend

questions.text: A new roommate is moving in. You...

options.text: Welcome them with homemade cookies
Hand them the house rules. Laminated
Grunt a hello
Plan a prank on them before they've even unpacked

questions.text: Your roommates invent a chaotic drinking game. You...

options.text: Commit completely, even though nobody understands the rules
Take it far too seriously
Sit it out and referee the arguments
Play along, laughing the whole time, and lose badly

questions.text: It's someone's birthday at the house. You...

options.text: Plan a themed surprise party
Make the surprise a prank
Throw a sophisticated dinner party
Handle the guest list — and the drinks

questions.text: You find out one roommate has been secretly paying less rent than everyone else — for years. You...

options.text: Draw up a spreadsheet of exactly what they owe
Keep quiet. Honestly, you're behind on rent too
Tell them straight to their face. Today
Let it go. They'd do the same for you

questions.text: You've fallen for your roommate — and acting on it could blow up the whole flat. You...

options.text: Pretend everything's fine while it very clearly isn't
Say nothing for months, then kiss them out of nowhere
Write them a letter. Several drafts
Date someone else and hope the feelings go away
